frame.description: CSS selector matching exactly one iframe/frame in the top document, or id:<frame-id> from frames for explicit/nested selection. Bare URLs and indices are not supported. Evaluation uses an isolated world, not page-owned JavaScript globals.

name: frame_eval

description: Start one native browser download to an absolute output filename; returns a background job

output.description: Absolute output filename. Must not exist; its parent directory must exist.

name: download.start

description: List download jobs in the existing session
name: download.list

description: Inspect a download job and its saved artifact. A completion receipt confirms verified file saving; inspect contents only when the task requires it.
name: download.get

description: Wait for a download and return its saved-file completion receipt. That receipt is sufficient to confirm saving. Timeout or caller disconnection does not cancel the transfer; inspect the same job rather than downloading again.
name: download.wait

description: Request cancellation of a download without deleting a completed artifact
name: download.cancel

description: Inspect bounded text using browser credentials; binary files use download.start

max_body.description: Raw text byte limit: default 8192, maximum 16777216; zero inspects headers only.

name: fetch

url.description: Optional URL to navigate to. If omitted, opens a blank tab.

An observable completion condition. Values are not copied into receipts, and
`Debug` prints only the kind.

Wait for the page URL.

oneOf.description: Wait for a rendered target.

contains.description: Accept a substring instead of an exact match.

oneOf.description: Wait for a form value.
Wait for a checked state.
Wait for selected option values.

oneOf.description: Resolve a pinned frontend node from an Element handle.

id.description: Chrome DOM node identifier for the original document.

oneOf.description: Match a CSS selector.

selector.description: CSS selector evaluated when the action runs.

oneOf.description: Match element text.

exact.description: Require an exact, trimmed text match.

oneOf.description: Match an exact placeholder attribute.
Match an explicit ARIA role.
Resolve a pinned node without retargeting a replacement.

LocatorSpec.description: A serializable locator. Frame identifiers and backend nodes are pinned identities.

frame_id.description: Pinned frame identifier, or the main frame when absent.

index.description: Explicit zero-based match index; absence requires a unique match.

query.description: Query used to resolve the target.

WaitSelectorState.description: The condition a `wait` selector must reach.

oneOf.description: Present in the DOM, rendered or not.
Rendered with visible CSS and a nonzero box.
Absent or no longer rendered.

state.description: What the selector must become. Defaults to visible.

name: captcha.datadome

name: captcha.turnstile

description: Accept the open alert, confirm or prompt dialog. A page with an open dialog is blocked until it is accepted or dismissed.

prompt_text.description: Text to enter for a prompt() dialog; ignored for alert and confirm.

description: Dismiss the open alert, confirm or prompt dialog
name: dialog_dismiss
